decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans and methos statement submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - Only manual excavation using shovels will be used to dig the foundations of the wall, and care will be taken not to damage any tree roots.
Condition : 5 - Bridging will be formed within the walls foundations using concrete lentils or similar.
Condition : 6 - The new walls bricks, bond, mortar and pointing shall accord with Technical notes 1 and 2 of the Bedford Park Society Handbook for Architects and Residents.
description: Re-building the existing boundary wall with gates to existing front elevation of existing house.
